_note: Shared, version-controlled Claude Code config for LingoLinq-AAC. The audit read-only write-blocker (.claude/hooks/audit-readonly-guard.sh) is intentionally NOT registered as a global hook here: it is wired per-agent via each finder's `hooks:` frontmatter so it scopes to the read-only audit finders ONLY and never blocks normal editing in the main session or for teammates. See .claude/agents/*-auditor.md and audit-reports/README.md.
_note_permissions: Context7 (mcp__context7__*) is denied in this regulated repo. The brain MCP master config enables Context7 user-scope (global), but it is a cloud documentation service: even the npx variant egresses the library name and query topic to context7/Upstash, a non-BAA third party. Denying the tool pattern here keeps that library/topic metadata off third parties during PHI-adjacent work. A user-scope server cannot be scoped by directory and disabledMcpjsonServers does not apply to it, so a project-level permission deny is the mechanism that actually works (same pattern as mcp__stripe__*). See ai-company-brain/outputs/docs/2026-06-17-tooling-adoption-phase-11a.md.
_note_github_mcp: The project .mcp.json attaches @modelcontextprotocol/server-github@2025.4.8 with whatever GITHUB_TOKEN carries. The Bash guards police `git`/`gh` but not MCP tools, so every write tool that server version exposes (all 12, verified 2026-09-12) is denied here; `gh` via Bash stays the sanctioned write path. This list is tied to the pinned version: bumping the pin in .mcp.json means re-enumerating the server's write tools and updating this list in the same PR.
